description: Convert a UK body weight given in stones and pounds to kilograms and grams. Uses exactly 14 pounds to the stone and 0.45359237 kg to the pound. Pounds are optional; give 11 st 7 lb as stone 11, pounds 7. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/stone-to-kg/

pounds.description: Extra pounds on top of the stones (0 to 13.99, optional)

name: hopi_stone_to_kg

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)
